notes.title: New Perspective - Now Available
notes.notes:
[p]🎉 [b]New Perspective is OUT NOW![/b] 🎉
Today’s the day.[/p][p]After months of writing, designing, editing, debugging (and let’s be honest—second-guessing everything), I’m incredibly proud to finally say:[/p][p]🕔 [b][i]New Perspective[/i] is officially live on Steam![/b]
📆 [b]July 17, 2025[/b]
🕘 [b]Available now — 5:00 PM CEST / 11:00 AM EDT / 8:00 AM PDT[/b]
👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2545010/New_Perspective/" style="button"]New Perspective[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p]💬 [b]What’s it about?[/b]
[i]New Perspective[/i] is a romantic adult visual novel where your choices shape the MC’s relationships with four unique women, each with her own story, struggles, and heart. [/p][p]Whether you’re here for the story, the relationships, or the steamy scenes, you’re in for something real.[/p][hr][/hr][p]❤️ [b]Featuring:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Four deeply written love interests[/p][/*][*][p]Branching paths and emotional choices[/p][/*][*][p]A full-length, adult narrative[/p][/*][*][p]Secret moments to discover and enjoy[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]👀 [b]If you like it…[/b]
Please consider leaving a review, sharing screenshots, or recommending it to friends. For a solo dev like me, [b]every bit of support makes a massive difference.[/b] 🙏[/p][hr][/hr][p]From the bottom of my heart:
Thank you to everyone who wishlisted, shared kind words, or showed excitement along the way. Your encouragement helped make this possible.[/p][p]Now it’s your turn to experience the story.[/p][p]🎮 [b]Play [i]New Perspective[/i] now
[/b][/p][p]Can’t wait to hear what you think. 💌[/p][p]— Vermilion Stardust[/p]

notes.title: Introduction - Love Interests
notes.notes:
[p]🗓️ [i][b]New Perspective[/b][/i][b] releases in just one week![/b] 🗓️
To celebrate, it’s time to introduce the four women who may just change the MC’s life—and yours, too.[/p][p]Below, you’ll find a short introduction to each love interest, along with a little secret or anecdote that [i]isn’t[/i] revealed in the game, but adds depth to who they are.[/p][p](📸 Character images below!)[/p][hr][/hr][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44491040/7febbf6e03ec6c87afc9c253477ecc18eb5ce568.jpg"][/img]
💙 Lilian[/h3][p]After losing her parents at a young age, Lilian came to live with the MC’s family. They’ve known each other ever since—sharing meals, memories, and the awkwardness that comes with growing up side by side.[/p][p][b]Fun fact:[/b]
When she first moved in, Lilian cried constantly. One night, a very confused and sleepy MC walked downstairs and told his stepmom with a completely serious face:[/p][quote][p][i]"I didn’t know angels could cry."[/i]
It’s a story that gets told way too often at family gatherings—and while the MC would rather forget it, Lilian secretly loves that he said it.[/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44491040/118f01723cee9cb0fee5bc8407e6c388ca2dedd7.jpg"][/img]
🌸 Emma[/h3][p]Emma and the MC went to the same high school, though their lives didn’t fully intersect until later. She was quiet, smart, and often the target of mean-spirited teasing. One day, the MC spoke up for her when no one else would—and she never forgot it.[/p][p][b]Fun fact:[/b]
Emma had a quiet crush on the MC ever since that day. She never dared to act on it, convinced he’d never see her that way. But even now, that memory still means the world to her.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44491040/0d12ba3b7a15ef3c6ee6aa1a0c777dedc27a7f03.jpg"][/img]
🔥 Haley[/h3][p]Confident, flirty, and the kind of woman who commands attention wherever she goes—Haley is magnetic. But she also hides more than she lets on.[/p][p][b]Fun fact:[/b]
Despite her carefree and rebellious image, Haley is actually a top student. She consistently ranks in the top 10% of her university class. She just prefers people [i]not[/i] to know—being a brainiac doesn’t really fit the persona she’s built for herself.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44491040/8e29fee10030687eb27c510ac382187f90db8037.jpg"][/img]
💔 Naomi[/h3][p]Naomi is bold, beautiful, and... guarded. She has every reason to be. As a kid, she was bullied for her weight—sometimes even by boys she thought she could trust.[/p][p][b]Fun fact:[/b]
When she first meets the MC, she tells him he looks like someone she wouldn’t like. What she means is—he reminds her of the kind of guys who used to pick on her. What she doesn’t expect is how different he turns out to be.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🎉 That’s your first look at the four main love interests of [i]New Perspective[/i]—each one shaped by their past, each one hiding more than they show.[/p][p]With one week to go, now’s the perfect time to wishlist the game and get ready to dive in.[/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2545010/New_Perspective/" style="button"]Store Page[/url][/p][p][i]Which girl will capture your heart?[/i] 💞
Let us know in the comments![/p][p]🗓️ [i][b]New Perspective[/b][/i][b] launches July 17, 2025 at 5:00 PM CEST / 11:00 AM EDT / 8:00 AM PDT![/b]
Set your alarms—and maybe your heart. 💌[/p]
